abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 2. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 76 | 450 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 110 | 450 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Side effects | 77 | 450 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
